author: smittyDX
quote: The characters are boring and unlikeable, especially Lucia. She's a terrible person who abandons her child to commit a robbery, doesn't tell the father about it and allows her son to get taken into state custody. She expects Jason to do everything for her despite doing nothing in return. And yet we're supposed to be sympathetic to her. Speaking of that, the game seriously has you spend considerable time doing domestic menial tasks like painting and roofing, working out, paying bills, getting groceries. It's bogged down in laborious realism severely limiting freedom of gameplay. The games insistence on maintaining your relationship with Lucia also bogs down your freedom of gameplay, this is one of the biggest problems with the game. It is a feminist dating sim made for women, by women, except in GTA and it doesn't fit. It's terrible. There's no option to explore other relationships like what you have in BG3 or Witcher. Jason is also incredibly dull, he's a cardboard cutout, he has no opinions and does everything Lucia asks. The game is incredibly slow, boring and unfun. Genuinely who at Rockstar thought a 10 hour prologue taking up almost ⅕ of the game was a good idea? The story is also boring. There's no good missions or fun to be had, compare that to the multiple heists in GTA 5 and RDR 2. There's no interesting NPCs or villains, and no conflict. The writing and dialogue are terrible, and are not well acted. All things considered, 13 years and a billion dollars, with a $100 price the and no disc, this game is a MASSIVE let down. It's not GTA. The graphics look nice though.
